submitted.rationale: Highest measured photocurrent (1.2e-6 A) at Co0.29V0.71. XRD shows weak peaks from a CoV2O6-like phase on top of the substrate (FTO) pattern. Photocurrent rose sharply from Co0.13 (9e-8 A) to Co0.29 and then fell at Co0.35 (8.8e-7 A), so the best composition is probably near Co ~0.3.

rejected.reason: XRD shows Co3O4 forming at high Co. Co3O4 is a weak photoanode, and photocurrent was already falling past Co 0.3
